Title: Generally Available: At-cost data transfer between Azure and an external endpoint

Body.Content:
We support customer choice, including the choice to transfer your data between Azure and environments outside of Azure. 

Azure now offers at-cost data transfer for customers and CSP partners in Europe transferring data via the internet between Azure to another data processing service provider. This situation is common where multiple services of different providers are used in parallel, in an interoperable manner. If your application is built to transfer data cross-cloud, please follow these steps to contact Azure Support to claim a credit. Please be aware of the eligibility requirements for this credit.   

The at-cost data transfer described above is available solely to organizations with a billing address within the European Economic Area (EEA), European Free Trade Association (EFTA), or the United Kingdom.  

Learn more.
